### Notes on `--index-url`

`--index-url` *replaces* PyPI for the whole install, including any build
requirements. The wheel (`vectorops-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl`) installs with
nothing but the local index. Installing from the sdist
(`--no-binary :all:`) additionally needs `setuptools` to build, which the local
index does not host -- either let pip see PyPI for build deps:

```sh
pip install --index-url http://localhost:8080/simple --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple vectorops==0.1.0
```

or reuse build tools already in the environment:

```sh
pip install --index-url http://localhost:8080/simple --no-build-isolation --no-binary :all: vectorops==0.1.0
```

## Layout

```
vectorops/__init__.py        the package; dotproduct() lives here
pyproject.toml               metadata, version 0.1.0
tests/test_dotproduct.py     behaviour of dotproduct, from the specification
tests/test_index_server.py   PEP 503 behaviour of the local index
scripts/serve_index.py       the index server (stdlib only)
scripts/serve_index.sh       start it on port 8080 in the background
scripts/build_and_publish.sh build sdist + wheel into dist/
scripts/verify_e2e.sh        full acceptance check end to end
```
